title: TipsProfileUpdateRequest
description: tips.profile-update-request@1: the body of tips.profile.update on OpenVibe.Tips. PATCH /api/v1/profiles/:creator (a usr_ id or handle; me for the signed-in person, creating their profile on first use): any of the settings below; revision, when given, must be the profile's current revision (409 tips.revision_conflict). A service opening a profile for a creator Tips has not seen (a usr_ id in the path) must give handle (and may give display_name and avatar_url). Needs an Idempotency-Key header (8-200 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -; 400 idempotency.key_required): a replay with the same key and body returns the first answer, the same key with another body is 422 idempotency.key_reused. Refusals are problem+json: 422 tips.invalid_input (a value out of range, an unknown voice, an unknown page or filter setting, an empty display_name, no handle when creating) or tips.text_too_long; 404 tips.creator_not_found; 403 capability.denied or tips.forbidden. Unknown top-level fields are ignored.

page_enabled.description: The public page and its indexing. true, 1, "1" and "on" count as yes; anything else as no.

accepting.description: Take new tips. true, 1, "1" and "on" count as yes; anything else as no.

tts_enabled.description: Text-to-speech requests. true, 1, "1" and "on" count as yes; anything else as no.

media_requests_enabled.description: Media requests. true, 1, "1" and "on" count as yes; anything else as no.

paid_message_min.description: The smallest paid message (1 to 1000000 bits).

tts_min_amount.description: The smallest text-to-speech request (1 to 1000000 bits).

media_request_min.description: The smallest media request (1 to 1000000 bits).

media_max_seconds.description: The longest media request (10 to 10800 seconds).

tts_max_chars.description: At least 20, at most TIPS_TTS_HARD_CAP (1200 by default).

page.description: What the public pages show; any other setting is refused.

words.description: Blocked words or phrases: a list, or one string separated by commas or new lines.

action.description: mask stars them out; hold keeps the paid message back for review.

links.description: Links in paid messages shown as [link].

filter.description: The word filter for paid messages; any other setting is refused.

handle.description: Creating a profile as a service: the creator's handle (their Network username).

avatar_url.description: Creating a profile as a service: an https URL.
